name: gig-tracker
description: 专为兼职/零工设计的工时与收入记工 APP

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','app.js','styles.css','manifest.json','icon-192.png','icon-512.png','sw.js'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f)}); console.log('Assets synced to www/');"
